batch_node.name: rampart-20x-playground vulnerabilities page v0.3.0
batch_node.description: The /playground/vulnerabilities page (three cards, three charts, a table of open vulnerabilities and a table of affected components) with a drill-in page per vulnerability and per component. Everything reads Searches over the compliance_core vulnerability, finding and scanner nodes; nothing names a scanner, a node id or a value.

node.name: Open findings
node.description: Open findings that concern a vulnerability.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities card-open
node.description: Open findings that concern a vulnerability.

node.name: On the CISA exploited list
node.description: Open findings whose vulnerability is on the CISA KEV catalog.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities card-kev
node.description: Open findings whose vulnerability is on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

query: MATCH (f:compliance_core__compliance_finding)-[:CONCERNS_COMPLIANCE_VULNERABILITY__compliance_core]->(v:compliance_core__compliance_vulnerability) WHERE f.data.status = "open" AND v.data.kev = true

node.name: Closed
node.description: Findings that are no longer open.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities card-closed
node.description: Findings that are no longer open: fixed or dismissed at the source.

node.name: CVSS score
node.description: Open findings by the CVSS base score of their vulnerability.

config.aria_label: Open findings by CVSS base score

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities cvss-spread
node.description: Open findings by the CVSS base score of their vulnerability.

query: RETURN v.data.cvss_score AS cvss, COUNT(f) AS n

entity.name: Components with the most open findings

node.name: Components with the most open findings
node.description: The ten components carrying the most open findings.

config.aria_label: Open findings by component, top ten

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities top-components
node.description: The components with the most open findings.

query: RETURN c.name AS component, COUNT(f) AS c

node.name: Severity by age
node.description: Each dot is a vulnerability with an open finding: when it was published, against its CVSS score; a bigger dot has more findings.

config.aria_label: Vulnerabilities with an open finding, by publication time and CVSS score

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities risk-map
node.description: One row per vulnerability with an open finding: its score, publication time and how many findings it has.

query: RETURN v.data.vuln_id AS id, v.data.cvss_score AS cvss, v.data.published_at AS published, COUNT(f) AS n

node.name: Open vulnerabilities
node.description: Every vulnerability with an open finding, most severe first. Click a row for its detail.

columns.title: CISA KEV
columns.header_tooltip: Whether CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog lists it.

columns.title: Components
columns.header_tooltip: How many components carry an open finding for it.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities open-vulns
node.description: Every vulnerability with an open finding, most severe first, and how many components carry it.

query: RETURN v.data.vuln_id AS id, v.data.title AS title, v.data.cvss_score AS cvss, v.data.kev AS kev, v.data.published_at AS published, COUNT(c) AS components

node.name: Open vulnerabilities per component
node.description: Every component with an open vulnerability. Click a row for its detail.

columns.title: Type
columns.header_tooltip: What kind of component it is.

columns.title: Highest CVSS
columns.header_tooltip: The highest CVSS score among its open findings.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities open-components
node.description: Every component with an open vulnerability, its type, how many open findings it carries and the highest CVSS score among them.

query: RETURN c.entity_id AS cid, c.name AS component, c.entity_type AS type, COUNT(f) AS vulnerabilities, MAX(v.data.cvss_score) AS worst

node.name: Vulnerability
node.description: The selected vulnerability.

columns.title: KEV due date
columns.header_tooltip: When CISA requires federal agencies to have remediated it.

columns.title: Exploitation
columns.header_tooltip: CISA's SSVC exploitation assessment: none, poc or active.

columns.title: EPSS
columns.header_tooltip: Probability of exploitation in the next 30 days, from FIRST.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities vuln-identity
node.description: The selected vulnerability: score, vector, exploitation signals, publication time and CWE.

query: RETURN v.data.vuln_id AS id, v.data.title AS title, v.data.cvss_score AS cvss, v.data.cvss_vector AS vector, v.data.kev AS kev, v.data.kev_due_date AS due, v.data.ssvc_exploitation AS exploitation, v.data.epss_score AS epss, v.data.published_at AS published, v.data.cwes AS cwes, v.data.record_url AS record

vuln_id.description: The vulnerability id, such as CVE-2026-86805.

node.name: Description
node.description: What the CVE record says.

columns.title: Required action
columns.header_tooltip: The action CISA requires, for a KEV entry.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities vuln-description
node.description: The selected vulnerability: the CVE description and, for a KEV entry, the action CISA requires.

query: RETURN v.data.description AS description, v.data.kev_required_action AS action

vuln_id.description: The vulnerability id, such as CVE-2026-86805.

node.name: Components with this vulnerability
node.description: Components that carry a finding for it.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities vuln-components
node.description: Components that carry a finding for the selected vulnerability, with the finding state.

query: RETURN c.entity_id AS cid, c.name AS component, c.entity_type AS type, f.data.status AS status, COUNT(f) AS findings

vuln_id.description: The vulnerability id, such as CVE-2026-86805.

node.name: Systems where it was found
node.description: Hosts that install an affected package.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities vuln-hosts
node.description: Hosts that install a package carrying an open finding for the selected vulnerability.

query: RETURN h.name AS system, COUNT(p) AS packages

vuln_id.description: The vulnerability id, such as CVE-2026-86805.

node.name: Scanner alerts
node.description: The alerts that raised it, in their repository.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities vuln-alerts
node.description: The scanner alerts, in their repository, that raised the selected vulnerability.

query: RETURN r.name AS repository, f.data.source_key AS alert, f.data.status AS status, f.name AS finding, f.data.summary AS summary

vuln_id.description: The vulnerability id, such as CVE-2026-86805.

node.name: Component
node.description: The selected component.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities comp-identity
node.description: The selected component: its type, open findings and the highest CVSS score among them.

query: RETURN c.name AS component, c.entity_type AS type, COUNT(f) AS vulnerabilities, MAX(v.data.cvss_score) AS worst

component_id.description: The entity id of the component.

node.name: Vulnerabilities
node.description: Every vulnerability the component has a finding for.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities comp-vulns
node.description: Every vulnerability the selected component has a finding for, open or closed.

query: RETURN v.data.vuln_id AS id, v.data.title AS title, v.data.cvss_score AS cvss, v.data.kev AS kev, v.data.published_at AS published, f.data.status AS status

component_id.description: The entity id of the component.

node.name: Systems where it runs
node.description: Hosts that install the component.

node.name: playground — vulnerabilities comp-hosts
node.description: Hosts that install the selected component, when it is a package.

component_id.description: The entity id of the component.

node.name: Vulnerabilities
node.description: What is open, how severe, and what carries it: three cards, three charts, then every open vulnerability and every affected component. Click a row to drill in.

node.name: Vulnerability
node.description: One vulnerability: what it is, how it scores, whether it is being exploited, the components that carry it and the systems where it was found. Open it from a row on the Vulnerabilities page.

node.name: Component
node.description: One component: its type and open findings, every vulnerability it carries and the systems where it runs. Open it from a row on the Vulnerabilities page.

entity.name: On the CISA exploited list USES_SEARCH card-kev
Components with the most open findings USES_SEARCH top-components
Open vulnerabilities per component USES_SEARCH open-components
Components with this vulnerability USES_SEARCH vuln-components
Systems where it was found USES_SEARCH vuln-hosts
Systems where it runs USES_SEARCH comp-hosts
